Full access lets all Lecturn tasks read and change all current Android user app data through the OS broker, and run commands and use the internet within the runtime. After the first unlock following a restart, this app data remains available to tasks in the background, including while the screen is locked. Actions can delete data or send it elsewhere.

Hardware Keystore keys and other Android profiles are excluded. Computer use (viewing and interacting with apps) is a separate selection, requires runtime support, and works only while the screen is visible and unlocked.

This native grant applies app-wide to all Lecturn tasks. Supervised, Auto edit, Auto, and Full provider approval modes remain per thread; they do not limit this app-wide grant.
